raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Manchester < Old English Mameceaster; Mame = Celtic river-name (breast-like), ceaster = Latin castra (camp)",
    "reading": "The breast-shaped river camp; a fortified place at the bend of the Mam.",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "cel"],
    "source": "Oxford Dictionary of English Place-Names",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "man + chester; chester = chest (box) + er (agent); man-chest-er = one who chests men",
    "reading": "The one who boxes or coffers humanity; a keeper of male souls in a chest.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "man (en) + chester (fr: château = castle) → man-château; also manche (fr: sleeve) + ster (en: star)",
    "reading": "Man's castle of sleeves; a star that sleeves the masculine — a garment of power.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Manchester → 'chest + man + er' → 'the chest of the man' → 'man's chest'",
    "reading": "The chest of man; a treasury of the masculine heart or breath.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "M-A-N-C-H-E-S-T-E-R → M (mater) A (anima) N (nous) C (corpus) H (hyle) E (essentia) S (spiritus) T (templum) E (et) R (ratio)",
    "reading": "Mother, soul, mind, body, matter, essence, spirit, temple, and reason — a microcosmic list.",
    "languages": ["la", "grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "M = 13 (death/transformation), A=1, N=14, C=3, H=8, E=5, S=19, T=20, E=5, R=18; sum = 106 → 1+0+6=7",
    "reading": "The number seven — completion, the seven planets, the sevenfold path of alchemy.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "man + ches + ter; ches = chess (game) + ter (earth) → man plays chess on earth",
    "reading": "Humanity's game of strategy upon the earthly board; a place of calculated moves.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Mameceaster → mam (breast) + ceaster (fort); also Old English 'mam' = mother",
    "reading": "Mother-fort; a nurturing stronghold, a breast-like citadel of the river.",
    "languages": ["en", "la", "cel"],
    "source": "A Dictionary of British Place-Names (Mills)",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "man (en) + chester (German: Kester = chestnut) → man-chestnut; also 'chester' as 'cheat' + 'er'",
    "reading": "The chestnut of man — a hidden kernel of wisdom within a spiky husk.",
    "languages": ["en", "de"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Manchester → 'chaste + men + r' → 'chaste men' + 'r' (res) → 'chaste men of the thing'",
    "reading": "Chaste men of the matter; purity of the masculine principle in alchemical work.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "M=40, A=1, N=50, C=3, H=8, E=5, S=60, T=9, E=5, R=80 (Greek isopsephy) → sum = 261 → 2+6+1=9",
    "reading": "Nine — the number of initiation, the muse, the threshold of completion.",
    "languages": ["grc", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "man + chester → 'man' + 'chest' + 'er' → 'chest-er' = one who chests, i.e., encloses; 'man' = human",
    "reading": "The encloser of humanity; a container of the human essence — a vessel.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
]
